id: go-rclone-sftp-powershell-incomplete-quote-escape
title: PowerShell path quoted by escaping only ASCII apostrophe, allowing command injection via smart
  quotes
summary: A path is wrapped in PowerShell single quotes after doubling only the ASCII apostrophe. PowerShell
  also treats the Unicode smart quotes U+2018, U+2019, U+201A and U+201B as single-quote delimiters, so
  an attacker-controlled filename can close the string literal and inject statements into the remote command
  line. This leads to remote command execution on the SFTP server.
cwe:
- CWE-78
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- go
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: e122fba1a57641b63a580aa26c026903a84e2e88
  vulnerable_ref: e122fba1a57641b63a580aa26c026903a84e2e88^
  patched_ref: e122fba1a57641b63a580aa26c026903a84e2e88
  repository: https://github.com/rclone/rclone
rule:
  message: 'Value is wrapped in single quotes for PowerShell after escaping only the ASCII apostrophe.
    PowerShell also treats the Unicode smart quotes (U+2018, U+2019, U+201A, U+201B) as single-quote delimiters,
    so a crafted filename can break out of the literal and inject commands. Use a replacer that doubles
    all of these characters.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: '"''" + strings.ReplaceAll($S, "''", "''''") + "''"

        '
    - pattern: '"''" + strings.Replace($S, "''", "''''", -1) + "''"

        '
  - pattern-not-inside: 'strings.NewReplacer(..., "‘", ...)

      '
fix:
  guidance: When quoting a string for PowerShell with single quotes, double every character PowerShell
    accepts as a single-quote delimiter, not only the ASCII apostrophe. That includes U+2018, U+2019,
    U+201A and U+201B. Use a shared strings.NewReplacer for this and apply it to the path before wrapping
    it in apostrophes.
  example: "var powerShellQuoteEscaper = strings.NewReplacer(\n    \"'\", \"''\",\n    \"\\u2018\", \"\
    \\u2018\\u2018\",\n    \"\\u2019\", \"\\u2019\\u2019\",\n    \"\\u201A\", \"\\u201A\\u201A\",\n  \
    \  \"\\u201B\", \"\\u201B\\u201B\",\n)\n\nfunc quotePS(p string) string {\n    return \"'\" + powerShellQuoteEscaper.Replace(p)\
    \ + \"'\"\n}\n"
